An '''Imperial warlord''' was a member of the [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]]. During a meeting of the Council, this [[human]] agreed with their fellow [[warlord]] [[Gideon]] as the [[Moff]] noted how the Imperial warlords upon the Council confined their individual activities to their own specific [[sector]]s. They also showed tentative agreement to Gideon in his suggestion that in the absence of the missing [[Grand Admiral]] of the [[Imperial Navy]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], the Shadow Council should seek out new leadership, nodding to this.<ref name="Chapter 23: The Spies" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The warlord first appeared in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]," the seventh episode of [[The Mandalorian Season Three|season three]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' which was released on [[April 12]], [[2023]].<ref name="S3 Dates">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1598416900689743873|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-12-1|quote=The Mandalorian and Grogu return March 1 only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ytQHE}}</ref> They were portrayed by [[Imelda Corcoran]].<ref name="Chapter 23: The Spies" />
